title: D-TR-2 identity translations remain in the primary translated arm
recorded_by: Claude Code, at the investigator's written instruction of 2026-10-06

timing.statement: This decision was made and recorded before any translated judging and before any translated-arm result existed or was examined.

decision: The six D-TR-2 identity translations, selected by the deterministic frozen rule below, remain in the primary translated arm (T).
They are judged as-is: the Judge V2 input is the unchanged source span, exactly as persisted.
They are not treated as missing.

Explicit identity provenance stays attached downstream: translation_identity, translation_changed, identity_translation_reason, translation_stage_hash, effective_translation_config_hash and translation_record_sha256 must be present on every judge output and analysis row.

selection_rule.rule: A translation is an identity translation if and only if its source reasoning span contains zero Urdu-script letters (Arabic-script Unicode letters) and the persisted translated text is byte-identical to that span. Any other equal-text record fails QC closed.

identity_ids_provenance: Output of translator_launcher.canonical_qc() (read-only technical QC) on 2026-10-06. No list of the six existed before this date; the set is defined by the rule, not chosen by hand.
